environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 API deployed on an EC2 instance behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS termination happens at the application level using Kestrel with a server certificate only. No client certificate validation is configured. The NLB security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No API gateway or WAF is in the path. The application has no authorization middleware registered.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no TLS inspection
